decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The recommended amendments to the existing development contained in the reports 130306-002A "Acoustic Assessment of Installed Paint Spray Booth", dated April 2013, received 10/04/13; 130306-003, dated 18/04/13, received 19/04/13; and AA492/11/04/2013 "Airborne Emissions Assessment", dated 16/04/13, received 22/04/13 shall be carried out in all respects.
The works referred to above shall be completed on site no later than two (2) months from the date of this permission and maintained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 2 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for B2 (car spray booth) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 8:00am - 6:00pm, Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 1:00pm on Saturdays and the use shall not operate on Sundays.

Condition : 4 - No external lighting shall be included on elevations facing adjoining residential properties nor shall any lighting be installed that sheds light on to adjoining properties unless otherwise first agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The cumulative, measured or calculated noise created by the car spray booth and all associated plant shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB(A) Leq when measured at any directly adjoining residential property boundary.
description: Retrospective application for erection of  a car spray booth to the rear.
